verdict.rationale: Grok Bot's own docs say each Bot has a persistent cloud computer with a filesystem and terminal, so it can run code. A files-and-results page lists CSV, JSON, source-code files and Jupyter notebooks as handled outputs, and Team Bots are pitched for answering metrics questions from a data warehouse. However, no source explicitly describes writing and running analysis code on user data to produce charts or downloadable result files. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a code-execution data-analysis workflow, chart/visualization generation, documented file download of generated results, independent hands-on corroboration of data analysis
